title: A Novel Schur Decomposition-Based Weight Projection Method for Stable State-Space Neural-Network Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2605.14489v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Building black-box models for dynamical systems from data is a challenging problem in machine learning, especially when asymptotic stability guarantees are required. In this paper, we introduce a novel stability-ensuring and backpropagation-compatible projection scheme based on the Schur decomposition for the state matrix of linear discrete-time state-space layers, as well as an alternative pre-factorized formulation of the methodology. The proposed methods dynamically project the quasi-triangular factor of the state matrix's real Schur decomposition onto its nearest stable peer, ensuring stable dynamics with minimal overparameterization. Experiments on synthetic linear systems demonstrate that, despite a marginal increase in computational complexity, the method achieves accuracy and convergence rates comparable to those of state-of-the-art stable-system identification techniques. translated_title: 一种基于Schur分解的新型权重投影方法，用于稳定的状态空间神经网络架构
translated_abstract: 从数据中构建动力系统的黑箱模型是机器学习中的一个具有挑战性的问题，尤其是当需要渐近稳定性保证时。本文针对线性离散时间状态空间层的状态矩阵，提出了一种新颖的、能够确保稳定性且与反向传播兼容的基于Schur分解的投影方案，同时还给出了该方法的一种替代性的预因子化公式。所提出的方法将状态矩阵实Schur分解得到的准三角因子动态地投影到其最近的稳定对应矩阵上，从而以最小的过参数化代价确保动态系统的稳定性。在合成线性系统上的实验表明，尽管计算复杂度略有增加，该方法的精度和收敛速度仍可与最先进的稳定系统辨识技术相媲美。此外，更少的权重数量有助于（提升训练的便捷性）……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于Schur分解的权重投影方法，通过将状态空间神经网络中状态矩阵的准三角因子动态投影到最近的稳定矩阵上，以最小过参数化代价保证模型动态的渐近稳定性，且完全兼容反向传播训练。
